description: The 2002 forms of the TYPE clause's CONTROL HEADING / CONTROL FOOTING operand: the operand omitted, the optional word ON or FOR before it, and the OR PAGE phrase (kb/Work PB5116). §1985:XIII.3.9.2 Format 1 (printed folio XIII-20) braces the operand, {CONTROL HEADING | CH} {data-name-1 | FINAL} and {CONTROL FOOTING | CF} {data-name-2 | FINAL}, with no ON, FOR or OR PAGE; the ISO/IEC 1989:2002 format (13.16.53) brackets the operand, prints [ON | FOR] before it and OR PAGE after the heading's, and Annex F.2 item 87 QUOTES the OR PAGE addition. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitReportGroupType (the omission and OR PAGE) and VisitReportControlName (ON, FOR), once per written form (VCR row 7.45).
display: a 2002 form of the TYPE CONTROL HEADING/FOOTING operand (report group description)
citation: ISO §2023:13.18.57.2 Format 2, §2023:13.18.57.3 SR11; §1985:XIII.3.9.2 Format 1 braces the operand; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 87 (OR PAGE)
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (e) - the TYPE clause's control operand forms (85->2002)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRCO.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "VMRCO.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WK PIC 9 VALUE 1.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 CONTROL IS WK PAGE LIMIT IS 10 LINES.
01 CH1 TYPE CONTROL HEADING LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) VALUE "CH".
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) VALUE "DE".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
